scope: Independent integrated read-only audit of registry resolution, SSR and client hydration, every frozen card and teaching-gate state, thresholds and study metrics, gray semantics, failure disclosure, accessibility target size, responsive light/dark rendering, overflow, browser console, and DOM structure.

blocking_findings.finding: The UI names its fourth check `duration / interruption`, but Trial has no interruption or active-within-span field, evaluate() implements only t.duration >=40, and the ledger displays only active duration. The frozen receiver contract requires a >=40 ms candidate span, >=30 ms above threshold, and <=10 ms consecutive interruption. The demo therefore reports PASS for the interruption half without evidence or computation.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Represent the frozen card's interruption/active-span facts and evaluate/display the complete combined gate, or narrow the control and lesson task to a duration-only gate. Preserve the study row as immutable.

checks.evidence: DtmfDecisionLab resolves through the lazy registry to the default-exported client component; the lesson renders one live demo and no missing-component placeholder.

Production route returned HTTP 200 with initial Two-lows content in server HTML. After hydration the loading fallback count was zero, controls changed state, the timing slider mounted, and the production browser emitted no console warning, console error, pageerror, or hydration diagnostic.

Independent static enumeration covered 7 cards x 32 gate masks =224 states with no mismatch. Browser traversal covered all four presets, all four timing positions, every gate alone, every gate disabled, and all gates enabled. Frozen outputs never changed; teaching outputs and first-fail labels matched the card contract.

Visible immutable values exactly retain block energy 0.028, group energy 0.035, dominance >=3 dB, twist [-10,+5] dB, and absolute detuning <=2%; pair, detuning, twist, duration/interruption, and pause remain separate toggles. The combined duration/interruption implementation defect is scored separately.

Two lows preserves B vs REJECT, detuned and low-twist cards preserve their rejection reasons, Hard preserves key 7 and 50 ms latency failure, Short 22 ms rejects, Gray 26 ms remains local REJECT with null label, and Pause 38 ms preserves frozen key 2 until the teaching pause gate rejects.
Gray 26 ms displays `UNSCORED / NO LABEL`, supplies no invented spectral winners, and task completion audits the null label rather than counting REJECT as conformance correctness.
Every preset keeps the deterministic/non-conformance boundary plus PASS clean 512/512, PASS hard 1023/1024, FAIL negatives 637/640, and FAIL hard latency median 45/max 50 ms against <=40 visible.

All preset, gate, and reset controls are native buttons with aria-pressed and measured 44 px minimum height. The native range input measured 44 px high, accepted Home/ArrowRight/End, and exposed exact aria-valuetext for all four timing cases.

Manual and measured checks at 312x900 and 360x900 in light and dark themes kept every label, threshold, card, timeline, result, and caption legible. Controls wrapped without collision and state was repeated in text rather than color alone.
At 312 px the panel was 264 px wide and document scrollWidth/clientWidth were 312/312; at 360 px they were 312 and 360/360. No descendant crossed the panel bounds in any of four theme/width runs.
The route contains one DemoHost figure for this demo, zero nested figure elements, one internal accessible timeline SVG role=img, valid section/div structure, and no button nesting.
